datasets.name: product_counts
queryLines: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM meridian_staging.silver.payments) AS payments, (SELECT count(*) FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.payments) AS quarantined, (SELECT count(DISTINCT concat_ws('.', schema_name, table_name, column_name)) FROM meridian_staging.information_schema.column_tags WHERE tag_name LIKE 'class.%') AS protected_columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM meridian_staging.information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'quarantine') AND table_name NOT LIKE '\\_\\_%') AS tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM meridian_staging.information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'gold' AND table_name NOT LIKE '\\_\\_%') AS gold_tables, (SELECT count_if(status = 'degraded') FROM meridian_staging.gold.acquirer_status) AS degraded

datasets.name: failure_trend
queryLines: SELECT payment_date, acquirer_id, round(100 * failure_rate, 2) AS failure_pct FROM meridian_staging.gold.payment_failure_daily

datasets.name: daily_payments
queryLines: SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(created_at, 'Asia/Singapore')) AS day, country, count(*) AS payments FROM meridian_staging.silver.payments GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: quarantine_rules
queryLines: SELECT rule, count(*) AS quarantined_rows FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.payments LATERAL VIEW explode(_failed_rules) r AS rule GROUP BY rule ORDER BY quarantined_rows DESC

datasets.name: assets
queryLines: WITH counts AS (SELECT 'bronze' AS layer, 'bronze' AS schema_name, 'customers_changes' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.bronze.customers_changes UNION ALL SELECT 'bronze' AS layer, 'bronze' AS schema_name, 'payments' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.bronze.payments UNION ALL SELECT 'gold' AS layer, 'gold' AS schema_name, 'acquirer_hourly' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.gold.acquirer_hourly UNION ALL SELECT 'gold' AS layer, 'gold' AS schema_name, 'acquirer_status' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.gold.acquirer_status UNION ALL SELECT 'gold' AS layer, 'gold' AS schema_name, 'merchant_daily' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.gold.merchant_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'gold' AS layer, 'gold' AS schema_name, 'payment_failure_daily' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.gold.payment_failure_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantine' AS layer, 'quarantine' AS schema_name, 'customers' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.customers UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantine' AS layer, 'quarantine' AS schema_name, 'payment_duplicates' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.payment_duplicates UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantine' AS layer, 'quarantine' AS schema_name, 'payments' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.payments UNION ALL SELECT 'silver' AS layer, 'silver' AS schema_name, 'customers' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.silver.customers UNION ALL SELECT 'silver' AS layer, 'silver' AS schema_name, 'customers_history' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.silver.customers_history UNION ALL SELECT 'silver' AS layer, 'silver' AS schema_name, 'payments' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM meridian_staging.silver.payments), tagged AS (SELECT schema_name, table_name, count(DISTINCT column_name) AS protected_columns FROM meridian_staging.information_schema.column_tags WHERE tag_name LIKE 'class.%' GROUP BY ALL) SELECT n.layer, n.table_name, lower(replace(t.table_type, '_', ' ')) AS kind, n.row_count, coalesce(g.protected_columns, 0) AS protected_columns, date_format(from_utc_timestamp(t.last_altered, 'Asia/Singapore'), 'dd MMM HH:mm') AS last_changed_sgt, t.comment AS description FROM counts n JOIN meridian_staging.information_schema.tables t ON t.table_schema = n.schema_name AND t.table_name = n.table_name LEFT JOIN tagged g ON g.schema_name = n.schema_name AND g.table_name = n.table_name ORDER BY CASE n.layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN 1 WHEN 'silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'gold' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, n.table_name

datasets.name: gold_lineage
queryLines: WITH jobs AS (SELECT job_id, name, tags, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1), pipes AS (SELECT pipeline_id, name FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1) SELECT l.target_table_name AS gold_table, l.source_table_full_name AS built_from, coalesce(j.name, p.name, lower(l.entity_type)) AS built_by FROM system.access.table_lineage l LEFT JOIN jobs j ON l.entity_type = 'JOB' AND l.entity_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN pipes p ON l.entity_type = 'PIPELINE' AND l.entity_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE l.target_table_catalog = 'meridian_staging' AND l.target_table_schema = 'gold' AND l.source_table_full_name IS NOT NULL AND l.event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY gold_table, built_from

datasets.name: consumers
queryLines: SELECT CASE coalesce(entity_type, 'SQL') WHEN 'JOB' THEN 'jobs' WHEN 'PIPELINE' THEN 'pipelines' WHEN 'DASHBOARD_V3' THEN 'dashboards' WHEN 'SQL' THEN 'SQL and notebooks' ELSE lower(entity_type) END AS consumer, count(DISTINCT coalesce(entity_id, created_by)) AS consumers, count(*) AS read_events FROM system.access.table_lineage WHERE source_table_catalog = 'meridian_staging' AND event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY read_events DESC

datasets.name: job_counts
queryLines: WITH current AS (SELECT job_id FROM (SELECT job_id, name, tags, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1) WHERE tags['project'] = 'meridian-poc' AND tags['target'] = 'staging' AND delete_time IS NULL) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM current) AS jobs, count(*) AS runs, round(100 * count_if(result_state = 'SUCCEEDED') / count(*), 1) AS succeeded_pct FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_job_runs WHERE started_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND result_state IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: runs_per_day
queryLines: SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(started_at, 'Asia/Singapore')) AS day, lower(result_state) AS result, count(*) AS runs FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_job_runs WHERE started_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND result_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: jobs
queryLines: WITH current AS (SELECT job_id FROM (SELECT job_id, name, tags, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1) WHERE tags['project'] = 'meridian-poc' AND tags['target'] = 'staging' AND delete_time IS NULL) SELECT r.job_name, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE r.trigger_type WHEN 'CRON' THEN 'schedule' WHEN 'PERIODIC' THEN 'schedule' WHEN 'FILE_ARRIVAL' THEN 'file arrival' WHEN 'TABLE' THEN 'table update' WHEN 'ONETIME' THEN 'manual or another job' ELSE lower(r.trigger_type) END))) AS triggers, count(*) AS runs, round(100 * count_if(r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED') / count(*), 1) AS succeeded_pct, round(percentile(r.duration_s, 0.5)) AS median_seconds, date_format(from_utc_timestamp(max(r.started_at), 'Asia/Singapore'), 'dd MMM HH:mm') AS last_run_sgt, lower(max_by(r.result_state, r.started_at)) AS last_result FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_job_runs r JOIN current USING (job_id) WHERE r.started_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS GROUP BY r.job_name ORDER BY runs DESC

datasets.name: pipeline_counts
queryLines: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT origin.update_id) FROM meridian_staging.obs.pipeline_event_log WHERE timestamp >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS) AS updates, (SELECT sum(CAST(details:flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows AS BIGINT)) FROM meridian_staging.obs.pipeline_event_log WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress' AND details:flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows IS NOT NULL) AS rows_written, (SELECT round(sum(u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.default), 2) FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON p.sku_name = u.sku_name AND p.cloud = u.cloud AND p.currency_code = 'USD' AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time) WHERE u.custom_tags['project'] = 'meridian-poc' AND u.custom_tags['target'] = 'staging' AND u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS) AS cost_usd

datasets.name: rows_written
queryLines: SELECT origin.flow_name AS table_name, sum(CAST(details:flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows AS BIGINT)) AS rows_written, count(DISTINCT origin.update_id) AS updates, date_format(from_utc_timestamp(max(timestamp), 'Asia/Singapore'), 'dd MMM HH:mm') AS last_written_sgt FROM meridian_staging.obs.pipeline_event_log WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress' AND details:flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rows_written DESC

datasets.name: expectations
queryLines: SELECT expectation, sum(passed_records) + sum(failed_records) AS rows_checked, sum(failed_records) AS rows_failed, round(100 * sum(failed_records) / (sum(passed_records) + sum(failed_records)), 2) AS failed_pct FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_expectation_metrics GROUP BY expectation ORDER BY rows_failed DESC

datasets.name: cost_by_job
queryLines: WITH names AS (SELECT job_id, name, tags, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1) SELECT u.usage_date AS day, coalesce(n.name, lower(u.billing_origin_product)) AS job, round(sum(u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.default), 2) AS usd FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON p.sku_name = u.sku_name AND p.cloud = u.cloud AND p.currency_code = 'USD' AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN names n ON n.job_id = u.usage_metadata.job_id WHERE u.custom_tags['project'] = 'meridian-poc' AND u.custom_tags['target'] = 'staging' AND u.usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: health
queryLines: SELECT date_format(from_utc_timestamp(at, 'Asia/Singapore'), 'dd MMM HH:mm') AS at_sgt, source, name, status, detail FROM ( SELECT ended_at AS at, 'job run' AS source, job_name AS name, result_state AS status, termination_code AS detail FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_job_runs WHERE ended_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND result_state <> 'SUCCEEDED' UNION ALL SELECT ended_at, 'task run', concat(job_name, '.', task_key), result_state, termination_code FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_task_runs WHERE ended_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND result_state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'EXCLUDED', 'SKIPPED') UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, 'pipeline', coalesce(flow_name, 'update'), level, coalesce(error_message, message) FROM meridian_staging.obs.v_pipeline_events WHERE timestamp >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND level IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') UNION ALL SELECT checked_at, concat('check: ', check_name), concat_ws('.', table_name, column_name), 'BREACH', message FROM (SELECT check_name, checked_at, table_name, column_name, message, breached FROM meridian_staging.obs.drift_events UNION ALL SELECT check_name, checked_at, table_name, column_name, message, breached FROM meridian_staging.obs.freshness_events UNION ALL SELECT check_name, checked_at, table_name, column_name, message, breached FROM meridian_staging.gov.pii_coverage) WHERE breached AND checked_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS UNION ALL SELECT max(_quarantined_at), 'quarantine', rule, 'QUARANTINED', concat(count(*), ' payment rows') FROM meridian_staging.quarantine.payments LATERAL VIEW explode(_failed_rules) r AS rule WHERE _quarantined_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS AND reprocessed_at IS NULL GROUP BY rule ) ORDER BY at DESC

datasets.name: acquirers
queryLines: SELECT acquirer_id, status, round(100 * recent_failure_rate, 1) AS recent_failure_pct, round(100 * baseline_failure_rate, 1) AS baseline_failure_pct FROM meridian_staging.gold.acquirer_status ORDER BY status = 'degraded' DESC, recent_failure_rate DESC

queryLines: SELECT country, count(*) AS payments FROM meridian_staging.silver.payments GROUP BY country ORDER BY payments DESC
